rule.name: InvertedEqualsCheck
rule.message: This early out in equals(Object) returns false when the compared field is equal, while the other checks of the method return false when a field differs. The test is inverted: two equal objects compare as unequal and the method carries on for objects that differ, so equals is not even reflexive and sets and maps lose entries. Negate the comparison: if (!name.equals(that.name)) return false;.
